review_type: Independent read-only source review plus local fake-gh subprocess tests
reviewed_checks: Three concurrent distinct owned upload process groups maximum
Existing remote assets all verified before new mutation; no clobber or delete
Unchanged request resume and final exact remote asset set/SHA256/size checks
Exact actual tag target, public release identity/title/body before and after upload
Original validator/remote digest helper unchanged and all3 source hashes bound before import/work
Failed upload leaders remain owned through validation; exited leaders cannot leave live descendants
All API/tag/probe/create commands use scoped process groups with45second caps and remaining overall budget
Early SIGTERM handler precedes the first child; interruption and timeout cleanup affect only owned groups
Completed publication report remains schema-compatible with the original publisher
resolved_findings: Failed leaders were removed from tracking before validation; tracking and group cleanup now persist through verification
Initial metadata calls lacked timeouts; every network command now uses a bounded owned wrapper
Matching draft releases could be treated as public; drafts now fail
SIGTERM handler originally followed the first API call; installed before all child/network calls
limits: Local fake-gh tests establish lifecycle/scheduling behavior; real remote publication still requires actual final digest checks.
Interrupted partial remote assets are refused on resume and require explicit review; no automatic deletion.
No throughput speedup is claimed until an authorized real run measures it.
